question: Add an identity-count or identity-cap free_tier unit for per-identity billed secrets and IAM services, instead of mapping them to users or objects.
why: Infisical Free is denominated in 5 identities, where one identity is any human user or machine principal. The schema has no identity unit, so the draft uses users with metered_on identity-count and names the true unit in free_tier.notes.
